newsitem.title: USA: Panamsat sets management of merged company.
newsitem.headline: Panamsat sets management of merged company.

text.p: PanAmSat Corp said Wednesday an Office of the President will be formed for the new company being created by PanAmSat's merger with the Galaxy operation of Hughes Electronics Corp.
It also noted the merger remains subject to the approval of PanAmSat shareholders and the Federal Communications Commission following expiration of the U.S. antitrust review period.

The Office of the President will include Lourdes Saralegui, who will serve as executive vice president and who currently holds the same title with PanAmSat; Carl A. Brown, who will also serve as executive vice president and currently is senior vice president, Galaxy Satellite Services; Robert A. Bednarek, who will be chief technology officer and currently is PanAmSat's senior vice president, engineering & operations; and Kenneth N. Heintz, who will be executive vice president and chief financial officer and currently is corporate vice president, corporate development, Hughes Electronics.
